newsitem.title: SPAIN: NORDLB increases its 10-yr step-up Matador 2007.
newsitem.headline: NORDLB increases its 10-yr step-up Matador 2007.

text.p: Norddeutsche Landesbank will increase its 10-year bond with a step-up coupon by up to 10 billion pesetas, the lead manager and bookkeeper Deutsche Bank Morgan Grenfell in Madrid said.
The initial amount of the issue was 10 billion pesetas. No conditions have been changed for this additional tranche.
The first coupon is 5.4 percent, with the second one at 7.10 percent. Issue price is 101.5.
Issue date is July 28 1997, and maturity at July 30 2007.
The issue is callable at the end of the second year.
Ratings for S&P and Moody's are at AA1, and for IBCA AAA.
